text:
maya: Heads-up — we need SM occupancy + per-GPU queue depth telemetry for both Hosted and Dedicated pools so Console can show real-time hotspots and so routing policies can avoid saturated GPUs. Proposed minimal labels: pool, gpu_id, instance_type. Thoughts?

ben: +1 on visibility. Quick q: do we have a hardware SM occupancy counter? or is this an estimate from runtime?

priya: runtime note: we currently emit `nv_gpu_sm_util_percent` aggregated by pool in telemetry v1. Per-GPU SM util exists in the agent but wasn’t exported due to cardinality concerns. Queue depth (internal request queue_len) is logged locally but not in metrics. We can expose both but need to agree on label set and scrape cadence.

ben: cardinality is my main worry. If we add `model_version` it explodes. Keep it to `pool,gpu_id,instance_type` as maya suggested. For per-model insights we can roll up by model on the Console side using sampled traces.

jordan: Console/UX priorities: we want a per-pool heatmap (5m avg SM occupancy) and drilldown to per-GPU time series and a small table with current queue_depth, mem_used/mem_total, and 95p latency. Also want routing policy knobs: if `sm_occupancy_1m > 80% && queue_depth > 8` then divert to alternate pool or fallback smaller model. Need metrics at 10s-30s resolution to be useful for routing.

priya: runtime can emit 10s gauges. Two caveats: (1) export frequency impact on prometheus ingestion and cost, (2) GPU id label across Dedicated (customers may shard GPUs differently) — we should normalize `gpu_id` to local instance slot id, not PCI bus id.

leo: SRE/alerts: propose these alert candidates: `sm_occupancy_5m > 90% for 2m` per-pool, and `queue_depth > 20` per-pool/gpu for sustained 3m. Also add an anomaly alert for sudden jump in mem_used%.

ben: example PromQLs for Console rollup:```
# 95th percentile SM util across pool over 5m
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(nv_gpu_sm_util_percent_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool))

# current queue depth per gpu
max_over_time(request_queue_len{pool=~"hosted-.*|dedicated-.*"}[1m])
```

maya: @priya can the runtime put these metrics behind a feature flag so Dedicated customers opt in to per-gpu telemetry? For Hosted we can enable by default because we control tenancy.

priya: yes. We'll add a feature flag `telemetry.per_gpu_metrics=true/false`. For Dedicated default=false and require opt-in. We'll also add an anonymized `gpu_slot` label for privacy.

jordan: For Console storage and UI we should keep raw 10s metrics for 7d and roll up to 1m for 30d. That keeps the dashboard snappy. Can the infra team support retention policy changes?

ben: infra can support the retention plan but need an estimate on cardinality and TPS. Priya — can you share expected metric cardinality and per-instance cardinality numbers?

priya: rough estimate: Hosted: 2000 GPUs, Dedicated opt-ins add ~500. With labels {pool,gpu_slot,instance_type} — expect ~2500 time-series for `nv_gpu_sm_util_percent` per scrape. At 6 scrapes/min that's ~15k samples/sec across the cluster. Queue_len will be similar. We'll send a detailed calc in an RFC.

leo: add cost note: metric ingest increases cost. Ops wants tagging to exclude long-tail customers from retention.

maya: UX/ops integration: need routing policy UI additions — slider thresholds + toggle for `auto-evacuate` when above threshold. Also a small flyout that explains how occupancy vs queue_depth affects latency. @jordan can you mock a small panel for eng-review?

jordan: will do. Mock by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: telemetry/v2-pergpu feature branch deployed to staging (staging-telemetry flag enabled).

maya: great, can we get a PR for the telemetry schema change and an RFC for Console retention + alerts? I'll own the RFC and coordinate owners.

priya: I'm on the schema PR. Will include PromQL examples and cardinality calc.

ben: I'll produce infra cost + retention impact numbers once I get the cardinality calc.

leo: I'll draft alert thresholds and runbooks.

maya: Action items summarized: 1) priya -> schema PR and cardinality calc (due 3 business days), 2) jordan -> Console mock + routing UI spec (due 1 business day), 3) ben -> retention/cost estimate after PR, 4) leo -> alert runbooks. We'll reconvene in #eng-platform next Tue to sign off. :thumbsup:

priya: noted. Starting work now. :rocket:
